design_system.name: BurgerNetz Civic Canvas
design_system.description: A design system that bridges the gap between bureaucratic trust and community warmth. It uses a 'Swiss Utility' foundation (clean grids, high legibility) mixed with 'Organic Community' accents (warm photography, soft shadows).

layout.spacing_scale: Generous. Use p-6, p-8, p-12 for containers. Gap-6 or Gap-8 for grids.

buttons.primary: h-11 px-8 rounded-lg bg-slate-900 text-white hover:bg-slate-800 transition-all shadow-sm hover:shadow-md font-medium
buttons.secondary: h-11 px-8 rounded-lg border-2 border-slate-200 bg-transparent text-slate-900 hover:border-slate-900 transition-colors font-medium

cards.base: bg-white rounded-lg border border-slate-200 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200

inputs.base: h-11 rounded-lg border-slate-200 bg-white focus:ring-2 focus:ring-slate-900 focus:border-transparent transition-all

textures.noise: opacity-40 mix-blend-overlay pointer-events-none fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-[url('https://grainy-gradients.vercel.app/noise.svg')]

images.description: Diverse group of citizens in a park, representing community unity.
images.usage: Hero section background or main landing image
Issue reporting category card or example report
Issue reporting category card or example report
Issue reporting category card or example report

icons.style: Stroke width 1.5px or 2px. Consistent sizing (w-5 h-5 for UI, w-8 h-8 for features).

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets WCAG AA. Use slate-900 for main text on slate-50 backgrounds.
accessibility.labels: All inputs must have visible labels or aria-labels.

setup: Update 'tailwind.config.js' to extend the font family with Manrope and Inter.
Add the Google Fonts import to 'index.css'.
implementation_rules: Use the 'Manrope' font for all headings (h1-h3).
Do NOT use default Shadcn card styles blindly. Remove the 'card' class if it conflicts with the custom 'cards.base' style defined above.
For the Map View: Use 'react-leaflet' or similar. Style the map container with 'rounded-lg overflow-hidden border border-slate-200 shadow-sm'.
For the Dashboard: Use the 'dashboard_dense' grid layout. Keep widgets compact.
For the Landing Page: Use the 'marketing_bento' grid. Make it visual and spacious.
Use the provided image URLs for the respective sections. Do not use placeholders.
Ensure the 'Report Issue' form is split into clear steps or has distinct sections (Location, Details, Photo) to avoid overwhelming the user.

universal_guidelines: Do not use generic centered layouts. Use asymmetry where possible.
Avoid 'AI slop' gradients. Use solid colors or very subtle, purposeful gradients.
Ensure mobile responsiveness for all grids (stack to single column on mobile).
